mapper.delete: DELETE FROM receipts WHERE (type = 'manual' AND owner_id = #{projectId}) OR (type IN ('create_run', 'create_command') AND owner_id IN ( SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE project_id = #{projectId})) OR (type = 'agent' AND owner_id IN ( SELECT r.id FROM runs r JOIN sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId}))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO receipts (type, owner_id, request_id, request_hash) VALUES (#{type}, #{ownerId}, #{requestId}, #{requestHash})
mapper.select: SELECT request_hash FROM receipts WHERE type = 'manual' AND owner_id = #{projectId} AND request_id = #{operationId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM receipts WHERE type = 'manual' AND owner_id = #{projectId} AND request_id = #{operationId}
